title: A loan is overdue only while it is active after its due date, in the library's time zone
then: Not overdue at 23:59 on the due date in New York, though UTC is on the next day; overdue at 00:00 the next day, in summer and winter time. With the time zone set to UTC, the same instant is already overdue. Never overdue once returned.

title: A member with an overdue loan cannot borrow
then: At 23:59 on the due date in New York (already the next day in UTC), a second borrow succeeds. At 00:00 the next day in New York, a third borrow is refused as `member_overdue`. After the overdue loan is returned, it succeeds.

title: A member with 3 active loans cannot borrow a fourth
when: Lends three tools to one member.
then: The fourth borrow is refused as `loan_limit_reached`. After one return, the fourth borrow succeeds.

title: A tool that needs repair cannot be lent
